name: conflux-devkit
description: Conflux Development Kit - Professional monorepo for blockchain development

scripts.clean:all: pnpm clean:cache && pnpm clean:builds && pnpm clean:modules
scripts.clean:cache: rm -rf .turbo packages/*/.turbo ~/.cache/turbo node_modules/.cache node_modules/.vite packages/*/node_modules/.cache packages/*/node_modules/.vite 2>/dev/null && echo 'Cache cleaned'
scripts.clean:modules: rm -rf packages/*/node_modules pnpm-lock.yaml node_modules 2>/dev/null && echo 'Modules cleaned'
scripts.clean:builds: rm -rf packages/*/dist packages/*/.next packages/*/.nuxt packages/*/build packages/*/*.tsbuildinfo 2>/dev/null && echo 'Builds cleaned'
scripts.reset: pnpm clean:all && pnpm install && pnpm build
scripts.ports:check: lsof -i :3000 -i :3001 -i :3002 2>/dev/null || echo 'No processes on these ports'
scripts.ports:kill: lsof -ti :3000 -ti :3001 -ti :3002 2>/dev/null | xargs -r kill -9 && echo 'Killed processes on ports 3000, 3001, 3002' || echo 'No processes to kill'
scripts.session:token: curl -s http://localhost:3001/api/dev/session 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.sessionId // empty' || echo 'Backend not running or jq not installed'

author: Conflux DevKit Team
